question_en: Which statements are true? 1) Matter consists of molecules with gaps between them. 2) Molecules are in continuous random motion. 3) Only attractive forces act between molecules. 4) Brownian motion is the motion of the liquid's own molecules.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Modda molekulalardan tuzilgan, ular orasida bo'shliq bor. 2) Molekulalar tinimsiz betartib harakatda. 3) Molekulalar orasida faqat tortishish kuchlari ta'sir qiladi. 4) Broun harakati — suyuqlik molekulalarining o'z harakati.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Вещество состоит из молекул, между ними есть промежутки. 2) Молекулы находятся в непрерывном хаотическом движении. 3) Между молекулами действуют только силы притяжения. 4) Броуновское движение — это собственное движение молекул жидкости.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Kichik masofada molekulalar itarishadi (3 noto'g'ri); Broun harakati — mayda zarrachalar harakati (4 noto'g'ri).
Asos: MKN qoidalari.

uz: 3 — noto'g'ri: kichik masofada itarishish kuchlari ustun.
ru: 3 — неверно: на малых расстояниях преобладает отталкивание.
4 — неверно: движется мелкая частица в жидкости.
en: 1 and 2 are main principles of kinetic theory.
3 is false: repulsion dominates at small distances.
4 is false: it is a tiny particle in the liquid that moves.

rules.uz: Modda molekulalardan tuzilgan, ular betartib harakatda
rules.ru: Вещество состоит из молекул, они движутся хаотически
rules.en: Matter consists of molecules in random motion

distractors_ru.C: утверждение 4 неверно: броуновская частица не молекула

distractors_en.A: statement 3 is false: molecules also repel
distractors_en.C: statement 4 is false: a Brownian particle is not a molecule
distractors_en.D: statement 1 is true, while 3 and 4 are false

question_en: What amount of substance is contained in $48\ \mathrm{g}$ of helium ($M=4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) ($\mathrm{mol}$)?
question_ru: Какое количество вещества содержится в $48\ \mathrm{g}$ гелия ($M=4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) ($\mathrm{mol}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. ν = m/M = 48/4 = 12 mol.
Asos: modda miqdori massaning molyar massaga nisbati.

distractors_en.A: the mass was multiplied by the molar mass
distractors_en.D: the molar mass of hydrogen, 2 g/mol, was used
distractors_en.E: the molar mass was taken as 8 g/mol

question_en: Find the mass of an ozone molecule ($\mathrm{O_3}$) ($\mathrm{kg}$). The relative atomic mass of oxygen is $16$, $N_A=6\cdot10^{23}\ \mathrm{mol^{-1}}$.
question_uz: Ozon molekulasining ($\mathrm{O_3}$) massasini toping ($\mathrm{kg}$). Kislorodning nisbiy atom massasi $16$, $N_A=6\cdot10^{23}\ \mathrm{mol^{-1}}$.
question_ru: Найдите массу молекулы озона ($\mathrm{O_3}$) ($\mathrm{kg}$). Относительная атомная масса кислорода $16$, $N_A=6\cdot10^{23}\ \mathrm{mol^{-1}}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. M = 3·16 = 48 g/mol = 0,048 kg/mol; m₀ = M/Nₐ = 0,048/(6·10²³) = 8·10⁻²⁶ kg.
Asos: m₀ = M/Nₐ.

distractors_en.B: the mass of a single oxygen atom was found
distractors_en.C: the mass of an O₂ molecule was found
distractors_en.D: the molar mass was left in grams
distractors_en.E: the molar mass was multiplied by Nₐ

question_en: How many molecules are there in $3\ \mathrm{L}$ of water? $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $M=18\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, $N_A=6\cdot10^{23}\ \mathrm{mol^{-1}}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. m = ρV = 3 kg; N = mNₐ/M = 3·6·10²³/0,018 = 10²⁶.
Asos: N = (m/M)·Nₐ.

distractors_ru.B: масса не разделена на молярную массу

distractors_en.A: the mass was taken as 3 g
distractors_en.B: the mass was not divided by the molar mass
distractors_en.C: the mass was multiplied by the molar mass
distractors_en.E: the volume was taken as 3 m³

question_en: Find the ratio $\frac{N_1}{N_2}$ of the numbers of molecules in hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$, $2\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) and oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$, $32\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) of equal mass.
question_uz: Massalari teng bo'lgan vodorod ($\mathrm{H_2}$, $2\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) va kislorod ($\mathrm{O_2}$, $32\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) dagi molekulalar sonlari nisbatini $\frac{N_1}{N_2}$ toping.
question_ru: Найдите отношение $\frac{N_1}{N_2}$ чисел молекул в водороде ($\mathrm{H_2}$, $2\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) и кислороде ($\mathrm{O_2}$, $32\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) одинаковой массы.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. N = mNₐ/M, massalar teng: N₁/N₂ = M₂/M₁ = 32/2 = 16.
Asos: molekulalar soni molyar massaga teskari proporsional.

distractors.B: massalar teng bo'lsa, molekulalar soni ham teng deb olingan
distractors.C: ildiz olingan — tezliklar nisbati bilan adashtirilgan

distractors_ru.B: принято, что при равных массах число молекул одинаково
distractors_ru.C: взят корень — спутано с отношением скоростей

distractors_en.B: equal masses were assumed to give equal numbers
distractors_en.C: a square root was taken — confused with the speed ratio
distractors_en.D: an oxygen atom (16 g/mol) was used

question_en: The density of an ideal gas is $2.4\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ and the rms speed of its molecules is $500\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Find the gas pressure ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
question_uz: Ideal gazning zichligi $2.4\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, molekulalarining o'rtacha kvadratik tezligi $500\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Gaz bosimini toping ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
question_ru: Плотность идеального газа $2.4\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, средняя квадратичная скорость молекул $500\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Найдите давление газа ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. p = ρv²/3 = 2,4·500²/3 = 2·10⁵ Pa = 200 kPa.
Asos: MKN asosiy tenglamasi.

distractors_en.C: the factor 1/2 from kinetic energy was used

question_ru: Давление идеального газа $120\ \mathrm{kPa}$, концентрация молекул $3\cdot10^{25}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$. Найдите среднюю кинетическую энергию одной молекулы ($\mathrm{J}$).

distractors_en.E: kilopascals were not converted to pascals

question_en: The number density of gas molecules increased $2$ times and their mean kinetic energy decreased $4$ times. Find the pressure ratio $\frac{p_2}{p_1}$.
question_uz: Gaz molekulalarining konsentratsiyasi $2$ marta ortdi, o'rtacha kinetik energiyasi $4$ marta kamaydi. Bosimlar nisbatini $\frac{p_2}{p_1}$ toping.
question_ru: Концентрация молекул газа увеличилась в $2$ раза, средняя кинетическая энергия уменьшилась в $4$ раза. Найдите отношение давлений $\frac{p_2}{p_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. p ∼ nĒ: p₂/p₁ = 2·(1/4) = 1/2 — bosim 2 marta kamayadi.
Asos: p = ⅔nĒ.

distractors_ru.E: принято, что изменения компенсируют друг друга

distractors_en.C: the energy was taken to increase
distractors_en.D: the number density was taken to decrease
distractors_en.E: the changes were assumed to cancel out

question_en: Find the mean kinetic energy of the translational motion of gas molecules at a temperature of $77\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($\mathrm{J}$). $k=1.38\cdot10^{-23}\ \mathrm{J/K}$.
question_uz: $77\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ temperaturadagi gaz molekulalari ilgarilanma harakatining o'rtacha kinetik energiyasini toping ($\mathrm{J}$). $k=1.38\cdot10^{-23}\ \mathrm{J/K}$.
question_ru: Найдите среднюю кинетическую энергию поступательного движения молекул газа при температуре $77\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($\mathrm{J}$). $k=1.38\cdot10^{-23}\ \mathrm{J/K}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. T = 350 K; Ē = 3kT/2 = 1,5·1,38·10⁻²³·350 ≈ 7,2·10⁻²¹ J.
Asos: Ē = 3kT/2, T Kelvinda.

question_en: The absolute temperature of an ideal gas was increased $16$ times. How many times does the rms speed of the molecules increase?
question_uz: Ideal gazning absolyut temperaturasi $16$ marta oshirildi. Molekulalarning o'rtacha kvadratik tezligi necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: Абсолютную температуру идеального газа увеличили в $16$ раз. Во сколько раз увеличится средняя квадратичная скорость молекул?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. v ∼ √T: v₂/v₁ = √16 = 4.
Asos: v = √(3kT/m₀).

distractors_en.A: the square root was not taken

question_en: At the same temperature, how many times is the rms speed of hydrogen molecules ($\mathrm{H_2}$, $2\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) greater than that of helium atoms ($\mathrm{He}$, $4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$)?
question_uz: Bir xil temperaturada vodorod ($\mathrm{H_2}$, $2\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) molekulalarining o'rtacha kvadratik tezligi geliy ($\mathrm{He}$, $4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) atomlarinikidan necha marta katta?
question_ru: Во сколько раз средняя квадратичная скорость молекул водорода ($\mathrm{H_2}$, $2\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) больше, чем атомов гелия ($\mathrm{He}$, $4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$), при одинаковой температуре?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. v ∼ 1/√M: v₁/v₂ = √(M₂/M₁) = √(4/2) = √2.
Asos: v = √(3RT/M).

distractors.D: energiyalar tengligi tezliklar tengligi deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: равенство энергий принято за равенство скоростей

distractors_en.B: the square root was not taken
distractors_en.D: equal energies were taken to mean equal speeds

question_en: At what temperature of nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$, $28\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) is the rms speed of its molecules equal to that of helium atoms ($\mathrm{He}$, $4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) at $200\ \mathrm{K}$ ($\mathrm{K}$)?
question_uz: Azot ($\mathrm{N_2}$, $28\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) qanday temperaturada bo'lsa, uning molekulalari o'rtacha kvadratik tezligi $200\ \mathrm{K}$ dagi geliy ($\mathrm{He}$, $4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) atomlarinikiga teng bo'ladi ($\mathrm{K}$)?
question_ru: При какой температуре азота ($\mathrm{N_2}$, $28\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) средняя квадратичная скорость его молекул равна скорости атомов гелия ($\mathrm{He}$, $4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) при $200\ \mathrm{K}$ ($\mathrm{K}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Tezliklar teng: T₁/M₁ = T₂/M₂, T = 200·28/4 = 1400 K.
Asos: v = √(3RT/M).

en: For the speeds to be equal: $$\frac{T}{28}=\frac{200}{4}$$

distractors_en.A: the molar mass ratio was inverted
distractors_en.B: the temperatures were taken as equal
distractors_en.C: a square root of the mass ratio was taken

question_en: The absolute temperature of an ideal gas increased $6$ times and its pressure increased $2$ times. Find the ratio of the number densities $\frac{n_2}{n_1}$.
question_uz: Ideal gazning absolyut temperaturasi $6$ marta ortdi, bosimi esa $2$ marta ortdi. Molekulalar konsentratsiyalari nisbatini $\frac{n_2}{n_1}$ toping.
question_ru: Абсолютная температура идеального газа увеличилась в $6$ раз, а давление — в $2$ раза. Найдите отношение концентраций молекул $\frac{n_2}{n_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. n = p/(kT): n₂/n₁ = 2/6 = 1/3 — konsentratsiya 3 marta kamaygan.
Asos: p = nkT.

distractors_en.B: the pressure and temperature changes were multiplied
distractors_en.C: the pressure was taken to decrease
distractors_en.D: the number density was assumed unchanged
